sources: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
UK ETS technical guidance: Monitoring and Reporting Regulation 2018
current MRR technical-guidance inventory including UKETS01 general guidance
Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
UKETS01 MRR - General guidance for installations
Article 13 simplified monitoring-plan eligibility and transferred/inherent CO2, N2O and CCS monitoring boundaries
controls: SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_REGULATOR_DISCRETION
A standardised or simplified monitoring plan is proposed
Require regulator allowance under Article 13 rather than treating simplification as an operator entitlement.
Self-approving a simplified monitoring plan
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_ORGANISATIONAL_SCOPE
A simple installation seeks reduced administrative burden
Focus simplification primarily on organisational/data-flow/control procedure descriptions; activity data and calculation-factor duties remain applicable.
Dropping core monitoring duties when simplifying administration
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_ACTIVITY_DATA_STILL_REQUIRED
A simplified monitoring plan is used
Continue monitoring activity data using an applicable method such as invoices where suitable.
Treating simplification as exemption from activity-data monitoring
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_CALCULATION_FACTORS_STILL_REQUIRED
A simplified monitoring plan is used
Continue determining calculation factors using applicable tiers or default values.
Omitting calculation factors under a simplified template
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_CONTROL_PROCEDURES_STILL_REQUIRED
A simplified monitoring plan is used
Retain proportionate data-flow and control procedures even when standardised descriptions are accepted.
Removing controls because the plan is simplified
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_RISK_ASSESSMENT_CENTRAL_GATE
A simplification is proposed
Use a simplified risk assessment as the central eligibility test.
Approving simplification without considering inherent and control risk
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_NO_UNDUE_MISSTATEMENT_RISK
The regulator evaluates a simplified plan
Allow it only where simplification does not create undue risk of misstatement in the emissions report.
Trading administrative convenience for material data risk
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_CONTROL_COMMENSURATE_GATE
Control activities and procedures are simplified
Require them to remain commensurate with identified inherent and control risks.
Using generic controls that are too weak for the actual risk
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_REGULATOR_JUSTIFICATION
A regulator approves simplified monitoring
Retain justification for why the simplified plan is appropriate.
Approval without an auditable rationale
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_OPERATOR_RISK_ASSESSMENT_OPTION
The regulator needs installation-specific evidence
The regulator may require the operator to perform the risk assessment supporting simplified-plan eligibility.
Assuming the regulator must perform all risk analysis itself
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_THREE_CLASS_DECISION
An installation is screened for simplification
Classify it as too complex, generally eligible, or requiring individual assessment.
Forcing every installation into a binary eligible/ineligible rule
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_PLAN_PARTIAL_TEMPLATE_OPTION
An installation requires individual assessment
Allow only selected simplifications from standardised templates where appropriate.
Applying an all-or-nothing simplified template to a mixed-risk installation
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_CEMS_EXCLUSION
The installation applies a measurement-based CEMS approach
Treat it as too complex for a simplified monitoring plan under the guidance indicators.
Applying broad Article 13 simplification to CEMS monitoring
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_PFC_N2O_EXCLUSION
The installation carries out PFC- or N2O-emitting activities listed in the relevant UK ETS scope
Treat it as too complex for simplified monitoring-plan treatment.
Oversimplifying high-complexity non-CO2 monitoring
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_CCS_EXCLUSION
The installation performs CO2 capture, transport or geological storage activities
Treat it as too complex for simplified monitoring-plan treatment.
Oversimplifying CCS monitoring chains and transfer accounting
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_FALLBACK_EXCLUSION
The installation applies an Article 22 fall-back methodology
Treat it as too complex for simplified monitoring-plan treatment.
Simplifying a methodology already used because standard tiers are not applied
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_CATEGORY_C_NONSTANDARD_FUEL
A category C installation uses source streams other than commercial standard fuels
Treat the installation as too complex for the simplified-plan indicator set.
Applying simplified monitoring to a high-emission nonstandard-fuel profile
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_NON_NLMC_MAJOR_STREAM
A category B or C installation has a major source stream measured with instruments outside national legal metrological control
Treat it as too complex for simplified monitoring-plan treatment.
Reducing control detail where major-stream metrology needs stronger evidence
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_LAB_ANALYSIS_REQUIRED
The installation must use laboratory analyses under Articles 32 to 35
Treat it as too complex for broad simplified-plan treatment.
Hiding analytical quality requirements inside a generic simplified template
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_MANY_MAJOR_STREAMS
The installation has more than three major source streams
Treat it as too complex for the guidance's broad simplification indicators.
Using a simple template for a structurally complex source-stream inventory
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_HIGH_RISK_MULTIPLE_METHODS
The installation applies several materially different monitoring methodologies
Treat it as too complex for broad simplified-plan treatment.
Losing method-specific controls in a generic plan
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_ELIGIBLE_AB_ONLY_NATURAL_GAS
A category A or B installation has only natural gas as its fossil source stream
Treat it as generally eligible for consideration of a simplified monitoring plan, subject to regulator risk assessment.
Rejecting a low-complexity profile without risk-based assessment
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_ELIGIBLE_COMMERCIAL_STANDARD_FUELS
An installation uses only commercial standard fuels and has no process emissions
Treat it as generally eligible for simplified-plan consideration.
Applying full organisational burden where the monitoring profile is standardised
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_ELIGIBLE_INVOICE_ACTIVITY_DATA
An installation can exclusively use invoices for activity-data monitoring
Count this as a positive simplification indicator.
Ignoring a low-risk traceable activity-data route
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_ELIGIBLE_DEFAULT_CALC_FACTORS
An installation can exclusively use default values for calculation factors
Count this as a positive simplification indicator.
Demanding complex analytical procedures where default values are the applicable route
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_ELIGIBLE_LIMITED_FOSSIL_STREAMS
An installation has a limited number of fossil-carbon source streams
Count this as a positive simplification indicator and move to individual assessment when stream count becomes high.
Treating a many-stream installation as simple solely because each stream is individually simple
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_SOURCE_STREAM_COUNT_OVER_TEN_REVIEW
The number of source streams exceeds ten
Trigger an individual assessment rather than automatically applying the general eligibility indicator.
Using a simplified template despite cumulative source-stream complexity
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_ELIGIBLE_MINOR_DEMINIMIS_ONLY_CO2
Fossil CO2 arises only from minor and de-minimis source streams
Treat the installation as generally eligible for simplified-plan consideration, subject to regulator assessment.
Overburdening a genuinely low-complexity emissions profile
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_BIOMASS_DOES_NOT_AUTOMATICALLY_DISQUALIFY
An otherwise eligible installation also monitors biomass source streams
Do not treat biomass presence alone as disqualifying simplified-plan eligibility.
Rejecting simplification solely because biomass is present
PASS
SIMPLIFIED_BIOMASS_BASE_PROFILE_TEST
An installation combines biomass with an otherwise eligible fossil monitoring profile
Assess eligibility against the underlying fossil profile and applicable biomass controls rather than assuming complexity from biomass alone.
Conflating biomass monitoring with automatic simplified-plan ineligibility
PASS
